name: neon-night-drive-android
description: 霓虹夜行 Android App 封裝（Capacitor）

scripts.sync: node prepare-www.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.add-android: node prepare-www.js && npx cap add android
scripts.apk:debug: node prepare-www.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: node prepare-www.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease
